changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.comment: Replace the five legacy system roles with the canonical tenant RBAC model while preserving custom roles and remapping every role foreign key before deletion.
changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM "${schema}".user_session AS user_session USING "${schema}"."user" AS tenant_user, tenant_context WHERE user_session.user_id = tenant_user.id AND tenant_user.tenant_id = tenant_context.tenant_id;

DELETE FROM "${schema}".role AS legacy_role USING resolved_role_mapping AS legacy_role_mapping WHERE legacy_role.id = legacy_role_mapping.legacy_role_id AND UPPER(TRIM(legacy_role.name)) IN ( 'DEMO_STAFF', 'LINE_MANAGER', 'HR_ADMIN', 'ACCOUNTING_APPROVER', 'TENANT_ADMIN' );
